name: Sample Plumbing Co.
headline: Same-day plumbing repairs for homes across Lexington and nearby towns.
intro: From a dripping faucet to a burst pipe, we fix it right the first time and leave your home cleaner than we found it.

services.name: Leak detection
services.detail: Hidden leaks found without tearing up walls.

services.name: Fixture installs
services.detail: Faucets, toilets, sinks and garbage disposals.
